description: Marmorino — Colore: Verde antico & pale grey Collezione: Sectile 1729 Codice: 5801 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Medium Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 32.5 cm × 69 cm Toni: Green MARMORINO takes its name from the traditional Venetian plaster finish — a surface that mimics the qualities of stone through layered application rather than actual marble. In the SECTILE 1729 collection, MARMORINO does the inverse: it translates the inlaid marble patterns of the altar of I Gesuiti directly onto printed cotton, capturing in striking detail the confident, bold linework of the church's stone decoration. The result is a surface that is austere without being somber — high contrast lines against a bright, textured field whose organic character (random horizontal and vertical repeat, organic scale) gives the design the quality of the stone itself: no two installations are identical. Produced in collaboration with Venetian Heritage. Part of the SECTILE 1729 collection , inspired by the baroque marble patterns of Venice's I Gesuiti Church.
